notes: MySQL 9.x (innovation track). GTID-based asynchronous replication with SOURCE_AUTO_POSITION, replica in super_read_only; ProxySQL 3 splits SELECTs to the reader hostgroup (source+replica) and everything else to the source.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  tier VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  parent_id INTEGER,
  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  depth INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sku VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs JSON,
  active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  payload JSON,
  value_num DECIMAL(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  qty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)
fts_setup: CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ft_products_description ON products (description)

clone.tool: CLONE LOCAL DATA DIRECTORY + START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS
clone.notes: clone plugin physical hot copy (no external tool), scratch instance replays the source binlog with GTID auto-positioning and stops before the bad transaction

steps.name: clone status
steps.cmd: SELECT state, error_no, gtid_executed FROM performance_schema.clone_status

steps.name: START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS
steps.cmd: CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO SOURCE_HOST='source', SOURCE_PORT=3306, SOURCE_USER='repl', SOURCE_PASSWORD='replpass', SOURCE_AUTO_POSITION=1, GET_SOURCE_PUBLIC_KEY=1; START REPLICA UNTIL SQL_BEFORE_GTIDS='141f5f04-b02a-11f1-821f-7aaf666c07c6:256'
